seeds.context: DudeRobe (duderobe.com) is a Shopify store with 28 products on sale or coming soon, centred on robes and tops ($68-$134), plus pants and shorts ($61-$72), $25 graphic tees, and bundles and sets ($98-$339). The range includes the DudeRobe, a reversible DudeHoodie, a 1-Second Flannel, The Hef smoking-jacket robe, and a SheRobe, plus kids, family and couple bundles. Most products are aimed at men, and four are sports-fan editions (UFC, University of Michigan, All-American).
